title: Lamb Kebabs with Syrian Kick
description: A flavorful and spicy lamb kebab recipe with a touch of Syrian cuisine. Perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to trim any excess fat

ingredients.name: Spices: cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika
ingredients.notes: Mix together in a small bowl

ingredients.name: Syrian kick spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets or online

instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, keto flour, spice blend, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Mix well to coat.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
